name: Friday Night X-Plosion

date.source: The broadcast's own on-air billing as 'the first ever telecast for GNW,' posted 30 March 1998.

no_appearances_reason: Part one of a three-part telecast names an announce team and its main-event wrestler; a dozen-plus further named wrestlers and stables appear across the fuller broadcast and the fed's own wider spring run, which this pass did not read in full. Registering a few names from one part of one show would leave a visibly partial roster; held at wing tier per the tier rule and the holdings bar for a dedicated future pass.
notes: GNW's (Global Network Wrestling) own billed first telecast.
